item.title: Crypto Hack Spurs $463 Million in Customer Outflows at Bitget
item.description: Hacked crypto exchange Bitget recorded roughly $463 million in net outflows in the 24 hours into Tuesday, as customers moved assets off the platform following last week’s $388 million theft. “Bitget will replenish the Fund using its own capital, with the Fund targeted to be above $300 million within one week.” Chen said she “immediately got involved with the team” after waking up around the time of the hack at 2:30 a.m. The $464 million user protection fund Bitget had cited to assure customers their funds were safe has now fallen below $200 million, according to the three wallet addresses that Bitget cites as the source of the funds.

item.title: Full Senate Passes Measure to Reauthorize Federal Terrorism Insurance Backstop
item.description: 28 passed, by unanimous consent, legislation to reauthorize the federal terrorism insurance backstop. Related: Federal Terrorism Insurance Backstop Prompted by 9/11 Still Waits for Reauthorization “This action reflects strong bipartisan recognition that TRIA remains essential to maintaining economic stability, supporting investment, and ensuring the availability of terrorism risk insurance for businesses and communities across the country,” said Sam Whitfield, senior vice president of federal government relations and political engagement for the American Property Casualty Insurance Association (APCIA). While the federal backstop – essentially a reinsurance program that allows insurers to cover terrorism risk – doesn’t sunset until the end of next year, the insurance industry pushed for action early to avoid uncertainty or disruption in the marketplace.

item.title: Wrongful Death Notice Filed in Kirk Death As Report Highlights University’s Security Deficiencies
item.description: Utah Valley President Jon Anderson said in a statement that the school has a responsibility to “learn from the findings of this review, and follow through on its recommendations.” The report echoes complaints made by Kirk’s family Last week, Kirk’s family announced a wrongful death notice — a precursor to a possible lawsuit — accusing Utah Valley officials of hastening his death with a string of “reckless decisions.” They included failing to conduct an adequate risk assessment, failing to establish a secure perimeter and failing to have first responders immediately available, which led to Kirk being taken to a hospital in a private vehicle instead of an ambulance. Charlie Kirk’s political organization insisted he speak outdoors at the Utah university where he was assassinated, despite security concerns from campus officials who then failed to properly assess dangers including a potential rooftop shooter, according to a report released Friday. An external review released by Utah Valley University found that the school failed to conduct a formal security assessment, did not create a written event action plan and deferred critical decision-making to Turning Point USA, the Kirk-led organization that scheduled his appearances on college campuses across the U.S.

item.title: States Question Safety, Challenge FAA Review of Commercial Drone Delivery Rules
item.description: A group of 15 states and a Texas county on Monday sued the US Federal Aviation Administration over an environmental review of planned commercial drone package delivery rules. The states — including New York, California, Massachusetts, Wisconsin and Michigan — and Harris County, Texas, said the FAA violated the law by failing to adequately analyze the potential environmental impacts of expanded drone package delivery operations. California Attorney General Rob Bonta said the “FAA’s programmatic environmental assessment falls far short of properly analyzing the environmental impacts that drone package delivery operations may have.” Drone delivery operations are already happening in states including California, Texas, Arkansas, Florida and Utah under the waiver process.

item.title: Kin Offers HELOC to California Homeowners
item.description: We started with home insurance, added condo and flood coverage this summer, and now we’re expanding into home financing.” California homeowners can check their rate or learn more about Kin’s HELOC at kin.com/heloc. A home equity line of credit (HELOC) is now available in California through Kin Financing, LLC affiliate, the direct to consumer insurer announced. Promising application to funding within five days allows California homeowners to use the funds to pay down higher-interest credit card debt, complete a renovation or repair, or invest in home-hardening projects such as defensible-space clearance and other wildfire mitigation upgrades, the insurer said.

item.title: Tiny Health Raises $33M To Explore What Gut Data Can Reveal About Future Health
item.description: “I was reading all this literature and asked my doctors about it, and none of my doctors knew what I was talking about.” A week after her son’s birth in 2020, she incorporated Austin-based Tiny Health . The financing brings Tiny Health’s total funding to $46 million, following a $4.5 million seed round in 2021 and an $8.5 million Series A in late 2023. Demand for Tiny Health’s at-home microbiome tests is growing.

item.title: Euler ILS Partners signs multi-year catastrophe risk analytics agreement with Moody’s
item.description: Euler ILS Partners, the specialist Swiss insurance-linked securities (ILS) investment manager, has signed a multi-year agreement with Moody’s to utilise the firms catastrophe risk models, analytics and exposure datasets to support its underwriting, portfolio management and decision-making across ILS opportunities. “This multi-year agreement reflects Euler’s confidence in Moody’s scientific rigor, transparent methodology, and long-standing commitment to advancing catastrophe risk analytics for the global insurance and capital markets industries.” Niklaus Hilti, Chief Investment Officer, Euler ILS Partners, added, “At a time when investors require greater transparency, consistency, and confidence in risk assessment, trusted analytics have never been more important. The agreement will allow Euler ILS Partners to utilise both natural catastrophe and cyber risk models and analytics, as well as a range of specialised peril and exposure datasets, to inform its evaluation of risk and its ILS investment decisions across global markets.

item.title: Micro-catastrophe bonds show growing potential for use in disaster risk financing: OECD
item.description: A trend towards smaller catastrophe bond issues becoming more feasible as market infrastructure improves has been highlighted by the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD), who suggest that what they term micro-catastrophe bonds have relevant application in disaster risk financing initiatives. A policy brief authored by Kensuke Molnar-Tanaka and Prasiwi Ibrahim of the OECD Development Centre calls for insurance and catastrophe bonds to be considered as part of the micro-disaster risk financing toolkit for emerging parts of Asia. The authors believe that, “Micro-disaster risk financing tools, including micro-disaster risk insurance and micro-catastrophe bonds, can better respond to the specific losses that communities experience, based on more granular knowledge of local risks and needs.” They elaborate, “While governments and their development co-operation partners have strengthened the use of large-scale, national disaster risk financing (DRF) instruments such as contingency funds, parametric insurance, and catastrophe bonds over the past decade, households, small businesses and local governments often remain financially exposed when disasters strike.

item.title: BMS Group appoints Paul Sheriff as Group CFO and Executive Director
item.description: BMS Group, an independent global insurance and reinsurance broker, has announced the appointment of Paul Sheriff as Group Chief Financial Officer (CFO) and Executive Director. In his new role, Sheriff will be based in London and will report to Nick Cook, BMS Group CEO. Prior to that, Sheriff held Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer roles at Legatum, Record plc and Arbuthnot Banking Group plc.

item.title: Antares to enhance Delegated Authority strategy with expanded VIPR partnership
item.description: “After 10 years of partnership, our expanded agreement will continue to provide Antares with access to the leading Delegated Authority platform, helping it build on its long history of successful, profitable underwriting in this space.” Antares selected VIPR to drive the next phase of its Delegated Authority strategy after conducting a thorough review of its operational requirements. Mark Graham, Chief Executive Officer, Antares at Lloyd’s, said: “We have worked with VIPR for more than a decade, and this expanded partnership reflects the next stage of our Delegated Authority strategy. Antares Global, a provider of insurance and reinsurance capacity, has expanded its partnership with VIPR, a provider of AI-driven technology for the global Delegated Authority insurance market, adding three products and signing a three-year renewal following a competitive tender.

item.title: Ascot strengthens leadership team with three executive appointments
item.description: These appointments are designed to advance the carrier’s strategy and position Ascot for its next phase of growth. In his expanded executive role, Pepper will lead Ascot’s efforts to elevate its underwriting capabilities and position the company for long-term success. He will work closely with Jonathan Zaffino, Group Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and President, along with Ascot’s segment CEOs to develop growth strategies, pursue business development opportunities, and strengthen coordination across the company’s UK, US and Bermuda businesses.

item.title: ANV Completes Acquisition of UK Motor Warranty MGA, Car Care Plan
item.description: ANV Group Holdings Ltd., the insurance intermediary platform, announced it has completed the acquisition of Car Care Plan (CCP) from AmTrust Financial Services Inc. “Car Care Plan is a fantastic platform and an important addition to ANV’s Credit & Protection platform, bringing meaningful scale in the global vehicle warranty market,” said Adam Karkowsky, chairman and chief executive officer of ANV. CCP is the number one provider of motor warranty in the United Kingdom and a market-leading warranty managing general agent (MGA), ANV said.

item.title: A-Cap Insurers Agree to Mediation in Rehab Dispute with SCDOI Director
item.description: “The department welcomes the insurers’ decision to put this distraction aside,” SCDOI Director Michael Wise said in a statement released Monday. Advantage Capital Holdings, parent of Atlantic Coast Life Insurance and Southern Atlantic Re, has dropped its lawsuit against the South Carolina insurance department director and has agreed to mediation instead. “We believe the decision to pursue mediation is a constructive step toward resolving the issues with the SCDOI and reducing uncertainty around the company,” reads a statement from A-Cap.

item.title: Oklahoma Court Finds Energy Company Liable for Excessing Prices During Winter Storm Uri
item.description: Oklahoma Attorney General Gentner Drummon announced that the state’s lawsuit against NextEra Energy Marketing for allegedly violating Oklahoma law by charging excessive prices for natural gas during Winter Storm Uri will proceed to trial. Drummond has filed several lawsuits against energy marketers alleging they artificially inflated natural gas prices during Winter Storm Uri in February 2021. “This ruling marks an important victory in our fight to hold NextEra accountable for the staggering prices Oklahomans were forced to pay during Winter Storm Uri,” Drummond said.

item.title: Northwestern Mutual launches Family Office Services
item.description: Northwestern Mutual has launched Family Office Services for clients with at least $50 million in net worth. Our Family Office Services team brings those fractured and fragmented pieces together – aligning investment, insurance, tax, and legacy strategies under one strategically connected approach. A dedicated family office model creates a single point of accountability across a client’s full financial picture.

item.title: Radian adds mortgage insurance quotes to Lender Price
item.description: Radian Guaranty’s mortgage insurance quotes are now available within Lender Price , allowing lenders and brokers to check rates without leaving the mortgage pricing platform. The integration gives Lender Price users access to RADAR Rates, Radian’s risk-based pricing model, which uses loan and borrower characteristics to calculate a quote. Radian Guaranty is the mortgage insurance subsidiary of Radian Group .

item.title: Aviva extends 10 year partnership with Founders Factory
item.description: Aviva it is extending its exclusive fintech partnership with Founders Factory, the global venture studio and accelerator. The decade-long strategic partnership has supported more than 60 startups to date, which have raised more than £500 million in investment since 2016. These include Tembo, a mortgage lending platform that recently saw Aviva expand access through its workplace pension proposition following a successful pilot, and Marrow, a connecter of AI agents including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to insurers’ pricing, underwriting and policy admin systems.

item.title: Colombia podría dar más tiempo para emitir las normas del open finance
item.description: Colombia podría tardar un poco más de lo esperado en llegar a la meta del open finance . El Ministerio de Finanzas quiere aprobar un decreto que propone dar seis meses más a la Superintendencia Financiera (SFC) para publicar los plazos de implementación de cuatro aspectos clave del modelo : la adopción de estándares tecnológicos y de seguridad , la activación del directorio de participantes , la definición de los indicadores de seguimiento y la fijación de estándares de la portabilidad financiera. Accede al análisis que impulsa la toma de decisiones en la banca latinoamericana Este contenido exclusivo está disponible solo para miembros registrados de iupana.

item.title: La nueva producción del canal de corredores crece un 16,41% en el primer semestre de 2026
item.description: Las primas netas de nueva producción del canal de corredores subieron un 16,41% interanual en el primer semestre de 2026, según el Índice de Evolución de Ventas (IEV), que elabora PRISMA, de ebroker. Por ramos, Autos tuvo el mayor crecimiento del semestre, con un 18,19%. Motocicletas subió un 14,36% y Hogar, un 8,30%.

item.title: Algoritmos y liderazgo: ¿puede la inteligencia artificial perpetuar el techo de cristal?
item.description: La inteligencia artificial ha irrumpido con fuerza en la gestión de personas. Herramientas capaces de analizar miles de currículos en segundos, predecir el rendimiento de los empleados, identificar perfiles con potencial de liderazgo o recomendar promociones internas se están incorporando de forma creciente a los procesos de recursos humanos.

item.description: Con la Universidad del País Vasco (UPV) de fondo, que la vio crecer y formarse en Matemáticas, nos sentamos en sus jardines para conversar con María José Rodríguez, directora general de Lagun Aro.

item.title: Matter Intelligence Debuts Roof-Condition Platform
item.description: We’re giving insurers a way to bring the condition of the asset itself into their risk decisions.” Physical Condition as a Risk Signal According to Matter, the platform can support underwriting by assessing roof condition at the point of quote, reducing reliance on physical inspections and referrals. (Image credit: IIR.) Matter Intelligence (London) plans to unveil a space-based property intelligence solution for insurers at ITC Vegas 2026, combining spectral sensing and AI to assess the physical condition of residential roofs at scale. Vishnu Sridhar, Co-Founder and CEO, Matter Intelligence.

item.title: MGAs Can Differentiate by Closing the Data Trust Gap
item.description: Carriers bear the risk but depend on data produced closest to it by MGAs. As a growing share of delegated business flows through MGAs outside carrier ownership, an MGA that requires extensive data reconstruction becomes more vulnerable to being deprioritized. From Data Delivery to Data Confidence For forward-looking MGAs, this is not simply a volume problem.

item.title: GM Faces Down Fuel Prices With Big Trucks and Bigger Engines
item.description: GM will be starting production of the trucks and bigger engines just as fuel prices have risen to nearly $5 a gallon and diesel prices hit a record. Despite steep fuel prices, Chevrolet Vice President Scott Bell says the company is adding production of V-8 engines and elevated trucks that are raised up for off-road driving because consumers want more than GM can currently build. Forget about starry-eyed goals to go all electric by 2035 that once anchored Chief Executive Officer Mary Barra’s goal of doubling revenue: The company runs on truck profits, and the all-new versions of the Silverado and Sierra will come with bigger engines and a plan to produce even more of them.

item.title: AM Best: US Mutual Insurers Doubled Net Income in 2025
item.description: property/casualty mutual insurers doubled compared to 2024 to about $42.6 billion in 2025 as underwriting income surged to about $14.8 billion from a loss of $7.2 billion in 2024. Best report on the segment, the rise in net income was also driven by a modest 2% decline in loss and loss adjustment expenses despite underwriting expenses increasing 5.8% in 2025 compared to the year prior. The list of top mutual insurers typically does not move much from year to year and that was the same in 2025, with the top 25 accounting for more than 83% of total NPW from mutuals.

item.title: Wisedocs Launches Legal Intelligence at ITC Vegas 2026, Giving Insurance Defense Teams AI Analysis of the Full Claim File, Starting with Depositions and Demand Letters
item.description: Legal Intelligence enables insurance defense teams to analyze legal documents — starting with deposition transcripts and demand letters — against a claims organization’s verified medical records and claim history, giving claims professionals and defense counsel a single view of what was said under oath, what is being claimed in the demand, and what the medical evidence and claimant history actually show. View Series New early-access Wisedocs AI product cross-references legal documents — starting with deposition transcripts and demand letters — against verified medical records and claim history, built only for the insurance defense side of the claim. Unveiled at ITC Vegas 2026 , Wisedocs, the leading claims decision intelligence platform , today announces the launch of Wisedocs Legal Intelligence , now available in early access, bringing the disjointed medical and legal sides of a claim together.

item.title: Marsh launches Archer platform for life and annuity reinsurers, sidecars, SPIs and cells
item.description: With the life and annuity reinsurance space seeing a wave of interest from both internal and external sponsors, including third-party capital providers, Marsh has launched a new platform initiative named Archer that is designed to help sponsors quickly set up and launch a new life and annuity reinsurance structure including sidecars. Those structures can ultimately range from standalone reinsurance vehicles, through life and annuity reinsurance sidecars, including special purpose reinsurers, dedicated reinsurance cells and standalone segregated accounts, Marsh said. Archer by Marsh is a new service and platform to support asset managers and life and annuity insurers as they establish and operate reinsurance businesses, leveraging Marsh’s shared operating infrastructure while the sponsors retain ownership and strategic control.

item.title: Catastrophe bond soft market not yet at 2017 levels, but could last another year: Lane Financial
item.description: In its last analysis of the catastrophe bond market earlier this year, Lane Financial had said that the outstanding market yield of non-impaired natural cat bonds was no longer as soft as it had been at the end of 2025, but the firm also highlighted that investor returns had been eroded by falling secondary market prices . The current soft market in catastrophe bonds and insurance-linked securities (ILS) is not yet at the depressed levels seen in 2017, analysis from consultancy Lane Financial LLC shows. But the company suggests the soft cat bond market could last another year, if 2026 continues to run loss-free.

item.title: ILS fund gains accelerate, cat bonds particularly strong. Average August return 1.39%: ILS Advisers
item.description: Insurance-linked securities investment fund strategies, across catastrophe bonds and private ILS, saw returns accelerating in August 2026, as the average ILS fund performance reached 1.39% and cat bond funds had a particularly strong month, latest data from the ILS Advisers Fund Index shows. For August 2026, ILS Advisers reports the average return across its index constituent ILS funds was 1.39%, which now becomes the best month of the year and the strongest single month of ILS fund performance since October 2025 for this Index. For 2026, August’s performance lifts the average ILS fund return for the year so far to 6.56%, which continues to run at a slightly above average level despite the softening of the reinsurance market.

item.title: SiriusPoint and Sutton Special Risk launch new sport insurance product for colleges and universities
item.description: SiriusPoint, a specialty underwriter, has announced a new strategic partnership with Sutton Special Risk, a specialist managing general underwriter providing innovative accident and health insurance solutions, to launch a new insurance product, SportsSecure™. By combining their complementary strengths in underwriting, specialised insurance, and sports-related accident and health expertise, SiriusPoint and Sutton Special Risk aim to support brokers, colleges, and universities as they navigate the evolving NIL and revenue-sharing landscape. Sutton Special Risk brings that expertise, and together we are offering a thoughtful, specialized way to manage injury-related financial exposure and protect the long-term stability of their athletic programs.” “We are excited to partner with SiriusPoint to bring a dedicated solution to an increasingly important segment of the collegiate sports market,” said Christian Hanson, VP Sports at Sutton Special Risk.

item.title: HDI Global Belgium establishes aviation underwriting team for Benelux and Southern Europe
item.description: HDI Global Belgium, the Belgian business of international commercial and industrial insurer HDI Global, has created a dedicated Aviation underwriting team to serve brokers and clients across the Benelux and Southern European markets. Based in Brussels and led by Stijn Keppens, the new team sits within HDI Global’s Specialty aviation business and is intended to provide regional market access to the company’s wider aviation underwriting capabilities. “The launch of this team marks an important step in strengthening HDI’s specialist aviation capabilities across Europe,” commented Jamie Bowes, Global Head of Aviation at HDI Global.

item.title: Global Atlantic appoints Dan Farrelly as Head of IMO and IBD Channels
item.description: Global Atlantic, a provider of retirement security and investment solutions and a wholly-owned subsidiary of KKR, has announced the appointment of Dan Farrelly as Head of Independent Marketing Organization (IMO) and Independent Broker-Dealer (IBD) Channels. Based in New York City, Farrelly will lead Global Atlantic’s relationships across the IMO and IBD channels, working closely with distribution partners to identify opportunities for growth and expand access to Global Atlantic’s retirement strategies. Farrelly joins Global Atlantic from Prosperity Life, where he served as SVP, Head of Annuity Distribution.

item.title: Estonia Says Russia Behind Arson Attack on Defense Firm
item.description: Estonia’s government said with “full confidence” that Russian special services commissioned an August arson attack against a defense manufacturing facility in Tallinn. “The arson attack on Milrem in Estonia on the night of 15 August was an act of sabotage,” Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said in a press release on Tuesday. Read more: Russia’s Attacks on Europe Are Getting More Brazen and More Dangerous Estonian officials said the attack on the company that supplies unmanned vehicles to Ukraine is part of a broader Russian campaign of sabotage and aggression across Europe to deter support for Kyiv.

item.title: Samsung’s Insurance Arms Lead Korean Drive for Overseas M&A
item.description: South Korean banks and insurers are hunting for overseas deals to lift growth, signaling a broader outward turn by an industry that largely stayed home while companies including Samsung Electronics Co. Korean executives are studying the decades-long overseas expansion of Japanese financial institutions, hoping to replicate their successes while dodging the costly acquisitions and difficult integrations that accompanied some investments in emerging Asia. Read more: Tokio Marine Weighs More Than $10 Billion of International M&A “Going overseas is becoming almost unavoidable for Korean financial firms because the domestic market is mature and demographics are deteriorating,” said Jongmin Shim, Seoul-based head of research at CLSA Securities.

item.title: French Court Finds Swiftair Guilty of Corporate Manslaughter Over Mali Crash
item.description: The Paris Criminal Court found Spanish company Swiftair guilty of corporate manslaughter on Monday over the 2014 crash of an Air Algerie flight that killed 116 people in northern Mali. However, a French judge ordered the company to pay the maximum fine in France of €225,000 for corporate manslaughter, “or involuntary homicide,” after a three-week trial earlier this year over the crash of a Swiftair-owned MD-83 airliner. During the rare corporate manslaughter trial, prosecutors alleged negligence in the way Swiftair pilots were trained to deal with icy conditions and erratic data.

item.title: Assured Guaranty commits up to $248 million to Brightline Florida restructuring
item.description: Assured Guaranty has committed up to $248 million in financing tied to Brightline Florida’s restructuring, while saying that the operator responsible for bonds it insures has not filed for Chapter 11. Assured Guaranty has committed $70 million toward the senior debt portion. Brightline Trains Florida LLC, known as OpCo, remains outside the bankruptcy proceedings involving other Brightline Florida entities.

item.title: Skandia Colombia explora una capa de acceso al mercado de stablecoins para fintechs
item.description: La fiduciaria Skandia trabaja en una estrategia de innovación que permitirá a fintechs colombianas tener acceso al mercado de monedas estables a partir del próximo año. Regístrate gratis o inicia sesión para leer el artículo completo y descubrir: Perspectivas estratégicas sobre innovación, regulación y tendencias en banca digital y fintech Entrevistas con líderes que están transformando el sector financiero en la región Reportes y estudios que anticipan los cambios clave del mercado Acceso prioritario a información para tomar decisiones informadas y fortalecer tu liderazgo Únete a la comunidad de ejecutivos que marcan la diferencia en la transformación digital de la banca. item.title: FCA secures money back for victims of crypto fraud
item.description: Victims of a £1.5m crypto investment fraud will recover lost funds after the FCA obtained confiscation orders against Raymondip Bedi and Patrick Mavanga. These orders bring victims a step closer to getting money back. The FCA has identified and contacted victims of the fraud and will ensure that funds recovered through the confiscation process are returned to victims.

item.title: People Moves: BevCap Adds Gross as Business Development Executive
item.description: BevCap Management has added David Gross as a business development Executive, where he will focus on expanding the reach of the company’s Dealer Management Group (DMG) and Sharefield captive solutions throughout the Midwest and Western United States. Gross brings more than 18 years of insurance industry experience, with a career spanning both the carrier and brokerage sectors. He held middle-market roles with Sentry Insurance and Huntington Bank, where he developed extensive expertise in client and broker engagement before transitioning into the captive insurance space with Garnet Captive.

item.title: First Wild Screwworm Fly Detected in Texas Since Outbreak Began
item.description: The US Department of Agriculture has caught its first wild screwworm fly since the parasite was detected in the country’s livestock nearly four months ago, signaling the potential for continued spread even as overall cases have remained muted. The wild screwworm fly was detected in Brewster County, Texas, on Friday. The agency said in a Saturday post on X that it places traps “just outside of infested areas to avoid capturing sterile flies and better pinpoint where wild flies may be moving.” 🚨 USDA has confirmed the first wild New World screwworm fly in a trap in Brewster County, Texas.

item.title: Michigan Transportation Company Sued for Sexual Harassment
item.description: Davis Cartage Co., a transportation, warehousing and logistics company headquartered in Corunna, Michigan, violated federal law by allowing its president of logistics to sexually harass two female employees at its Owosso, Michigan location, the U.S. Such alleged conduct violates Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which prohibits discrimination based on the basis of sex, including sexual harassment. According to the EEOC’s lawsuit, in 2023, the president of logistics, who is also on the board of directors and part owner of the company, passed over more qualified applicants to hire two young women whose photos he found on social media.

item.title: Lendistry acquires Windsor Life Insurance
item.description: Small business lender Lendistry has acquired Windsor Life Insurance , adding a licensed life insurer to a business that already includes lending, asset management and insurance distribution. The acquisition follows Lendistry’s 2025 launch of LIFT, an insurance agency connecting small businesses with business and life insurance coverage. Windsor Life gives Lendistry a carrier alongside that distribution operation.

item.title: Experian brings credit insights to Google Gemini
item.description: By bringing consumer-permissioned Experian credit insights into Gemini, we can help consumers better understand their credit and put their own information to work for them, in addition to the products, services, and experiences we power directly for our clients.” – Jeff Softley, CEO of Experian North America. Experian has become the first personal finance app integrated with Google Gemini’s Connected Apps. US users can link their Experian accounts and ask Gemini about their credit rating and the factors influencing it.

item.title: THREE names new president and underwriting head
item.description: THREE has promoted Brandon Bauer to president and appointed Nick Smith head of underwriting and insurance product. Bauer previously held the underwriting and insurance product role. THREE said he helped shape the foundation of its commercial insurance offering after joining the company.

item.title: Las aseguradoras piden una reforma del IVA que tenga en cuenta el modelo de negocio sectorial
item.description: El marco vigente del IVA en la UE para los servicios financieros y de seguros data de los años setenta y, a juicio de Insurance Europe, ya no refleja el funcionamiento actual del seguro, generando complejidad e incoherencias entre Estados miembros.
